# Barbara Shaw

## Overview

- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Barbara Shaw is described as a tall and awkward girl. She has an appearance that makes her seem to have an excess of hands and feet.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Barbara Shaw is notably clumsy in her movements. She frequently trips over her own feet or those of others, with any rare occasion of her walking without incident being treated as an unusual event.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P0](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0000)_

## Traits

- clumsy  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P0](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0000)</sub>

## History

Barbara Shaw came to live with an aunt in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), having previously visited her [Aunt Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) the prior winter. She subsequently became one of the pupils taught by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)_
